pages.text: 'Grasses - Tinted Realms' provide custom grasses blocks, leaves and plant with many different colors. They can be divided into four categories:$(br) $(li)biomes colors, $(li)dye colors, $(li)resource colors, $(li)shades of green$(br)

$(br)A detailed list of all can be found in category:$(br2)$(l:colors_ingredients_list_category)Colors and Ingredients$()$(br2)Moreover, mod provides:$(br)$(li)some slab variants of vanilla blocks,$(br)$(li)counterparts of several other vanilla blocks,$(br)
$(br)$(li)few new features like the ability to use bone meal on plants that didn't have that option before,$(br)$(li)few additions not strictly related to the matter of the mod$(br2)
